title: Booking Lead Time, Rush Fee and Open Order Limits of the Personal Services Plan
content:
Service visits under the Personal Services Plan are booked as orders. Three tier figures apply to booking: the hours of notice before the scheduled start below which a booking is a rush booking, the fee per rush booking, and the maximum number of booked orders not yet delivered or cancelled that a plan may hold at a time.

| Tier | Rush booking threshold (hours of notice) | Rush booking fee (USD per order) | Maximum open orders |
|---|---|---|---|
| Personal Services Pay-As-You-Go Plan | 48 | 15.00 | 10 |
| Personal Services Essentials Package | 48 | 15.00 | 10 |
| Personal Services Companion Package | 48 | 15.00 | 10 |
| Personal Services Comfort Package | 48 | 10.00 | 10 |
| Personal Services Premier Package | 48 | 0.00 | 10 |
| Personal Services Concierge Package | 48 | 0.00 | 10 |

## Points of reading

- The rush threshold of 48 hours and the limit of 10 open orders are the same on every tier.
- The rush booking fee is 15.00 USD on the Pay-As-You-Go Plan, the Essentials Package and the Companion Package, 10.00 USD on the Comfort Package, and 0.00 USD on the Premier and Concierge Packages.
- Hypothetical case: an order booked 30 hours before its start under the Comfort Package is a rush booking, the 30 hours being below the 48-hour threshold, and the fee for it is 10.00 USD.
